technology_name: Raw Banana-Based Functional Food Products Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management.
description: Processes for the development of dehydrated and powdered raw banana functional breakfast mixes and health products. The technology processes green banana pulp using size reduction devices, milling, and drying.
applications: • Manufacturing of low-glycemic therapeutic breakfast mixes • Production of functional green banana powder ingredients • Processing of clinical nutrition foods for diabetes management • Formulation of digestive health supplements
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
